text: Take orders on a register, an iPad or a phone, and add to a check that has already gone to the kitchen.
Send orders to the kitchen screen and to the kitchen and receipt printers. The kitchen sees only what is new.
alt: The kitchen screen: order tickets in columns, each with its items and a Bump button

text: Floor plans by room, with the tables where they really are.
Sold-out items marked right on the menu, with the count left (“3 left”) and a “Running Low” flag.
alt: The menu on a phone: some items marked Sold out, one marked 3 left, one marked Running Low

text: A time clock with corrections, side work lists, and a shift log for handover notes.
Close the day with a check of open checks and the cash you should have.
Reports that add up to what each bill actually charged.
alt: The Products report: items, quantities and paid subtotals with a total

text: Roles that say who may do what, with every change on the record.
alt: The change log: who changed what and when, with before-and-after detail

text: Your records stay on a machine you own. Nothing leaves it unless the owner turns it on.
